schemas.headline: Why Enroll Devices to Microsoft 365 Business Premium
schemas.description: Discover why enrolling devices to Intune via Business Premium gives SMBs enterprise-grade security, visibility, and control -without enterprise complexity.

mainEntity.name: What's the difference between Business Standard and Business Premium?

acceptedAnswer.text: Business Standard (£10.30/user/month) gives you Office apps, email, and Teams -but no device management or advanced security. Business Premium (£18.10/user/month) adds Intune for device management, Defender for Business antivirus, Conditional Access for smart security policies, and more. The £7.80 difference replaces multiple third-party tools that would cost far more separately.

mainEntity.name: What does 'enrolling a device' actually mean?

acceptedAnswer.text: Enrolling a device registers it with Microsoft Intune so you can manage it centrally. Once enrolled, you can push security policies (like requiring encryption), deploy apps automatically, see device compliance status, and remotely wipe it if lost. The user experience barely changes -they just sign in with their work account and the device configures itself.

mainEntity.name: Will this slow down our computers or be intrusive?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Intune policies run silently in the background. Users won't notice anything different except that their new laptop 'just works' out of the box. We configure sensible defaults -not heavy-handed restrictions that frustrate staff. You get security without the friction.

You have options. You can require full enrollment (giving you complete management), or use 'app protection policies' that only manage company data within specific apps -leaving personal data untouched. Most SMBs we work with provide company devices, but BYOD is fully supported if that's your model.

mainEntity.name: We're already using Google Workspace -does this still apply?

acceptedAnswer.text: If you're on Google Workspace, you face the same device management challenges -you just solve them differently. However, many businesses use both (Google for some things, Microsoft for others). If you're considering consolidating, Business Premium gives you email, productivity apps, AND device management in one platform. We can help you evaluate whether consolidation makes sense.

For most SMBs, we can migrate from Standard to Premium and enroll devices within 1-2 weeks. The license upgrade itself is instant. Enrolling devices can often be done gradually -new devices enroll automatically, and existing devices can be enrolled during a scheduled 'security day' with minimal disruption.

mainEntity.name: What happens to our existing security tools?

acceptedAnswer.text: Business Premium often replaces them entirely. Defender for Business replaces third-party antivirus. Built-in email filtering replaces separate spam tools. Conditional Access replaces standalone MFA tools. We'll audit your current stack and show you exactly what can be consolidated -typically saving money even with the Premium uplift.

mainEntity.name: Is this just for laptops, or mobile phones too?

acceptedAnswer.text: Both. Intune manages Windows, macOS, iOS, and Android devices. If staff access company email on their phones, those devices can be enrolled too -ensuring data is protected regardless of which device someone uses.

content.text: Control Take Control of Your Devices Unmanaged devices are accessing your company data right now. Intune and Autopilot change that -giving you visibility, security, and control without the complexity. Home Resources Why Enroll Devices to Business Premium Essential Guide Does This Sound Familiar? "We've got a mix of everything -some stuff in SharePoint, some in Dropbox, a few people still use personal Gmail. I think most laptops have antivirus but I'm not certain. Oh, and we've just bought three new laptops for the team starting next month." - Conversation we have weekly Data scattered across platforms. New devices set up manually. No idea what's being saved where. This is the reality for most SMBs -and it's a security incident waiting to happen. The Unmanaged Device Problem No visibility into which devices access data Can't enforce encryption or security policies Files saved locally never get backed up No way to wipe a lost or stolen laptop What Changes When You Enroll Devices Microsoft 365 Business Premium includes Intune and Autopilot -enterprise device management made simple for SMBs. Without Device Enrollment Manual Setup Every Time Each new laptop requires hours of manual configuration -and something always gets missed No Visibility You don't know which devices are encrypted, have antivirus, or are even accessing your data Files Trapped on Devices Staff save to Desktop or Documents locally -when the device fails, the files are gone Stolen Laptop = Data Breach No remote wipe capability. You just have to hope encryption was enabled (it probably wasn't) Shadow IT Everywhere Company data ends up in Dropbox, Google Drive, USB sticks -wherever users find convenient With Device Enrollment (Intune) Zero-Touch Setup User signs in, device configures itself. Apps install, policies apply, security enforced -automatically Complete Visibility Dashboard shows every device, its compliance status, encryption state, and last check-in time Files Protected Automatically Known Folder Move redirects Desktop/Documents to OneDrive -files sync to the cloud without user action Remote Wipe Ready Laptop stolen? Wipe it remotely in minutes. Data protected even if device is lost Shadow IT Blocked Conditional Access ensures only compliant, enrolled devices can access company data The Business Premium Advantage These features work together to give you control without complexity. Windows Autopilot Zero-touch deployment New laptop? Ship it directly to the employee. When they sign in with their work account, the device automatically: Joins your organisation Applies security policies Installs required apps Enables BitLocker encryption Configures OneDrive backup No IT visit required. No manual setup checklist. Conditional Access Smart security policies Define rules for who can access what, from where, on which devices. For example: Block access from unmanaged devices Block logins from high-risk countries Require MFA for sensitive apps Only allow compliant devices Block risky sign-ins automatically Even stolen passwords won't get attackers in. Intune Policies Standardised configuration Push consistent settings to every device without touching them individually: WiFi passwords deployed silently BitLocker encryption enforced OneDrive Known Folder Move enabled Windows Defender configured Windows Updates managed Every device meets your security baseline. Defender for Business Enterprise-grade protection Not just antivirus -a complete endpoint protection platform: Next-gen anti-malware Attack surface reduction Ransomware protection Web content filtering Centralised dashboard Replaces Sophos, ESET, and similar -included in the license. Real-World Scenarios These situations happen in SMBs every day. The difference between crisis and non-event is device enrollment. The New Starter's Laptop The Shadow IT Sprawl The Compromised Account The Compliance Question The Leaver Who Didn't Leave See the Value Gap The price difference between Standard and Premium is often less than what you're already paying for separate tools. License Upgrade Calculator Select your current license to see the value gap. Business Basic (£4.90) Business Standard (£10.30) Current Setup Microsoft 365 Standard £10.30 Email & Calendar Web/Mobile Apps Desktop Apps (Word/Excel) No Device Management (Intune) No Advanced Phishing Protection No Conditional Access (Geo-block) Recommended Upgrade Business Premium Business Premium £18.10 Difference: Only £7.80 / month Everything in Standard Intune: Wipe lost laptops remotely Defender: Enterprise Antivirus included Azure P1: Block hackers by country To get these features separately with 3rd party tools would cost approx £15.00 extra. Upgrading saves you approx £7.20 per user vs buying separate tools! Upgrade My Licenses *Prices based on Microsoft UK RRP for Annual Commitment, paid monthly. Excludes VAT. The Upgrade Path Moving to Business Premium and enrolling devices is straightforward. Here's what to expect. 1 License Upgrade We upgrade your Microsoft 365 licenses from Standard to Premium. Takes effect immediately. 2 Configure Intune We deploy our tested security templates -policies for encryption, updates, OneDrive, and more. 3 Enroll Devices Existing devices enroll during a scheduled rollout. New devices auto-enroll via Autopilot. 4 Protected & Visible You now have a dashboard showing every device, its compliance status, and the power to act. Typical Timeline For most SMBs (10-50 users), the complete process takes 1-2 weeks from license upgrade to all devices enrolled. Users experience minimal disruption -most of the work happens silently in the background.
